name: Omega
meaning: A title of Jesus, signifying His eternal nature
notes: In Revelation 1:8, 21:6; 22:13 , Jesus is referred to as "the Alpha and the Omega," a title that emphasizes His eternal nature and His role as the beginning and the end of all things.

name: Orion
meaning: A prominent constellation mentioned in the Bible
notes: Orion, a prominent constellation, is mentioned in Job.9.9, 38:31; Amo.5.8 as a display of God's power and creative work in the heavens.

name: Passover
meaning: An annual Jewish feast commemorating the Exodus
notes: The Passover is an annual Jewish feast that commemorates the deliverance of the Israelites from slavery in Egypt, as described in Exodus 12, and is celebrated with specific rituals and offerings as prescribed in the Old Testament and observed in the New Testament.

name: Pharisee
meaning: A strict Jewish sect known for legalism and hypocrisy
notes: The Pharisees were a Jewish sect known for their strict observance of the law and oral traditions, often clashing with Jesus over matters of ritual purity, Sabbath regulations, and His claims to divine authority ( Matthew 23; Luke 11:37-54 ).

name: Pleiades
meaning: A star cluster mentioned as a display of God's power
notes: The Pleiades are a star cluster mentioned in Job.9.9; 38:31 as a display of God's creative power and in Amo.5.8 as evidence of God's control over the natural world.

name: Preparation_Festival
meaning: The day before the Sabbath or Passover
notes: The day of Preparation was the day before the Sabbath ( Mrk.15.42; Luke 23:54 ) or the day before the Passover ( Jhn.19.14, 31, 42 ).

name: Purim
meaning: Jewish festival commemorating the events in the book of Esther
notes: Purim is the Jewish festival celebrating the deliverance of the Jews from Haman's plot to destroy them, as recorded in the book of Esther ( Esther 9:26-32 ).

name: Raca
meaning: An Aramaic term of contempt meaning "empty-headed"
notes: Raca is an Aramaic term of contempt, meaning "empty-headed" or "foolish," which Jesus warned against using to insult others, equating it with murder ( Matthew 5:22 ).

name: Rahab
meaning: A poetic name for Egypt, representing a mythical sea monster
notes: Rahab is a poetic name for Egypt, often represented as a mythical sea monster that God defeated, symbolizing His power over the nations ( Psalm 89:10; Isaiah 51:9 ).

name: Rephan
meaning: A pagan deity worshipped by the Israelites in the wilderness
notes: Rephan was a pagan deity worshipped by the Israelites in the wilderness, for which God allowed them to be carried into exile ( Act.7.43 ).

name: Rimmon
meaning: A Syrian deity worshipped by Naaman
notes: Rimmon was a Syrian deity worshipped by Naaman, who asked for God's pardon for bowing down in Rimmon's temple ( 2Ki.5.18 ).

name: Sabbath
meaning: The seventh day of the week, set apart for rest and worship
notes: The Sabbath, meaning "rest," was the seventh day of the week, set apart by God as a holy day for rest and worship ( Exodus 20:8-11; Leviticus 23:3 ).

name: Sadducee
meaning: A Jewish sect that denied the resurrection and spirits
notes: The Sadducees were a Jewish sect that denied the resurrection, angels, and spirits, and often clashed with Jesus and the early church ( Matthew 22:23; Act.23.6-8 ).

name: Satan
meaning: The adversary, the devil, the tempter of humanity
notes: Satan, meaning "adversary" or "accuser," is the devil, the chief enemy of God and tempter of humanity, who seeks to hinder God's purposes and lead people into sin ( Job.1.6-12; Matthew 4:1-11; Revelation 12:9 ).

name: Selah
meaning: A musical or liturgical term of uncertain meaning
notes: Selah is a term frequently used in the Psalms and Habakkuk, likely a musical or liturgical direction, though its precise meaning is uncertain ( Psalm 3:2, 4, 8; Habakkuk 3:3, 9, 13 ).

name: Shebat
meaning: The eleventh month of the Jewish calendar
notes: Shebat is the eleventh month of the Jewish calendar, mentioned in Zechariah 1:7 as the date of one of the prophet's visions.

name: Sheminith
meaning: A musical term of uncertain meaning
notes: Sheminith is a musical term that appears in the titles of Psalms 6; 12; 1Ch.15.21 , possibly referring to a musical instrument, a part in music, or a melody.

name: Shibboleth
meaning: A Hebrew word used to identify Ephraimites
notes: Shibboleth was a Hebrew word used by the Gileadites to identify Ephraimites, who could not pronounce it correctly, resulting in the death of 42,000 Ephraimites ( Judges 12:6 ).

name: Shiggaion
meaning: A musical term in the title of Psalm 7
notes: Shiggaion is a musical term that appears in the title of Psalm 7, possibly indicating a specific style or genre of music.

name: Shigionoth
meaning: A musical term in the title of Habakkuk's prayer
notes: Shigionoth is a musical term that appears in the title of Habakkuk's prayer in Habakkuk 3:1 , possibly indicating a specific style or genre of music.

name: Shimeathite
meaning: A Kenite clan skilled in scribal arts
notes: The Shimeathites were a Kenite clan known for their scribal skills, mentioned in 1Ch.2.55 among the descendants of Salma.

name: Shushan_Eduth
meaning: A musical term or tune in the title of Psalm 60
notes: Shushan Eduth, meaning "Lily of the Testimony," is a musical term or tune mentioned in the title of Psalm 60, possibly referring to a specific melody or musical setting.

name: Sikkuth
meaning: A pagan deity worshipped by the Israelites
notes: Sikkuth, possibly an Assyrian deity, was one of the pagan gods worshipped by the Israelites, for which they were condemned to exile ( Amo.5.26 ).

name: Sivan
meaning: The third month of the Jewish calendar
notes: Sivan is the third month of the Jewish calendar, mentioned in Esther 8:9 as the month in which Mordecai's decree was written and sent to the provinces.

name: Stoic
meaning: A Greek philosophical school encountered by Paul in Athens
notes: The Stoics were a Greek philosophical school that emphasized reason, self-control, and the acceptance of fate, some of whom debated with Paul in Athens ( Act.17.18 ).

name: Sucathite
meaning: A Kenite clan skilled in scribal arts
notes: The Sucathites were a Kenite clan known for their scribal skills, mentioned in 1Ch.2.55 among the descendants of Salma.

name: Succoth-benoth
meaning: A Babylonian deity worshipped by the Sepharvites
notes: Succoth-benoth was a Babylonian deity worshipped by the Sepharvites, one of the peoples settled in Samaria by the Assyrian king ( 2Ki.17.30 ).

name: Tammuz
meaning: A Mesopotamian deity mourned by women in Jerusalem
notes: Tammuz, a Mesopotamian deity, was mourned by women at the north gate of the Jerusalem temple, a practice condemned by Ezekiel ( Ezk.8.14 ).

name: Tarpelite
meaning: A group of officials in the Persian Empire
notes: The Tarpelites were a group of officials in the Persian Empire who opposed the rebuilding of Jerusalem during the time of Ezra ( Ezra 4:9 ).

name: Tartak
meaning: An Avvite deity worshipped in Samaria
notes: Tartak was a deity worshipped by the Avvites, one of the peoples settled in Samaria by the Assyrian king ( 2Ki.17.31 ).

name: Tebeth
meaning: The tenth month of the Jewish calendar
notes: Tebeth is the tenth month of the Jewish calendar, mentioned in Esther 2:16 as the month in which Esther was taken to King Ahasuerus.

name: Thummim
meaning: Objects used with the Urim for divine guidance
notes: The Thummim, along with the Urim, were objects carried in the breastpiece of the high priest's ephod and used to seek divine guidance ( Exodus 28:30; Numbers 27:21 ).

name: Tirathite
meaning: A Kenite clan skilled in scribal arts
notes: The Tirathites were a Kenite clan known for their scribal skills, mentioned in 1Ch.2.55 among the descendants of Salma.

name: Urim
meaning: Objects used with the Thummim for divine guidance
notes: The Urim, along with the Thummim, were objects carried in the breastpiece of the high priest's ephod and used to seek divine guidance ( Exodus 28:30; Numbers 27:21 ).

name: Weeks
meaning: A Jewish agricultural festival celebrated 50 days after Passover
notes: The Feast of Weeks, also known as Pentecost, was a Jewish agricultural festival celebrated fifty days after Passover, commemorating the wheat harvest and the giving of the Law at Sinai.

name: Zealot
meaning: A member of a Jewish political faction
notes: The Zealots were a Jewish political faction known for their fierce opposition to Roman rule and their advocacy for armed resistance ( Matthew 10:4; Mrk.3.18 ).

name: Zeus
meaning: The chief god in Greek mythology
notes: Zeus, the chief god in Greek mythology, was identified with the Roman god Jupiter and was worshipped in Lystra ( Act.14.12-13 ).

name: Ziv
meaning: The second month in the ancient Hebrew calendar
notes: Ziv, the second month in the ancient Hebrew calendar, is mentioned in connection with the construction of Solomon's Temple ( 1Ki.6.1, 37 ).
